name: Rani ki Vav
summary: An inverted temple-style subterranean stepwell featuring seven terraced levels adorned with over 500 principal sculptures dedicated to Vishnu.

name: Hampi
summary: The vast ruins of the Vijayanagara capital set amidst granite boulder landscapes, renowned for the monolithic Stone Chariot and musical pillared mandapas.

name: Konark Sun Temple
summary: Conceived as a colossal celestial chariot for Surya drawn by seven stone horses, famed for its 24 intricately carved stone sundial wheels.

name: Amer Palace and Fort, Jaipur
summary: A hillside fort-palace synthesized from red sandstone and marble, overlooking Maota Lake, famous for the mirror-mosaic Sheesh Mahal and painted Ganesh Pol.

name: Great Stupa at Sanchi
period: Maurya to Shunga Epoch (3rd Century BCE–1st Century CE)
summary: One of India's oldest stone structures, preserving sacred Buddhist relics beneath a massive hemispherical dome framed by four elaborately carved ceremonial torana gateways.
